result.title: Abstract What Varies, Reuse Longer Patterns: Efficient Offline Chain-of-Thought Compression
result.summary: Offline chain-of-thought (CoT) compression creates shorter supervision for efficient reasoning, but per-example compressors repeatedly process similar expressions across traces, wasting compressor budget. Methods that reuse identical text across examples miss longer shared expressions when names, numbers, or formulas change from one question to another. We introduce CRAFT, which abstracts problem-specific details into slots to uncover partially lexicalized expression templates (PLETs) and clusters wording variants into families. Compressing each family representative once yields shared deletion or rewriting edits, which are applied with each occurrence's own details to construct compact, ordinary-text training targets. Compared with per-example rewriting, CRAFT Rewrite reduces weighted compressor budgets by a median 90.7% with a median accuracy loss of 1.21 percentage points, while generating shorter reasoning. Against cross-sample encoding, it shortens reasoning across all eight model-dataset settings by 25.3% on average and improves accuracy in five.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CRAFT，把具体题目细节抽象为槽位，识别部分词化的表达模板并聚类措辞变体，对每个族代表只压缩一次后复用删除或改写编辑，从而用更低压缩预算生成更短、仍为普通文本的 CoT 监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其「抽象细节、复用共享编辑模板」的思路可能为 LVR 中缩短推理轨迹监督、复用跨样本共享推理结构提供可核查的线索。
